verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is BILL's developer docs stating that S&E lets you "manage transactions & reimbursements," which confirms the product has a reimbursement capability but describes none of the employee flow. The AP payment-status and webhook material concerns vendor bill payments, not employee reimbursements, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented employee out-of-pocket expense submission, direct-deposit payout, reimbursement timing ('in days'), submission-to-payout status tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
